jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Coordinator

**Location:** Buena Park, CA | Onsite  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Temp-to-Hire  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Compensation:** $26.00–$27.00 per hour, depending on qualifications

Job Summary

The Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily project operations, including preparing quotes, processing orders, and coordinating project details with customers, vendors, and internal teams. This role helps ensure accurate data entry, effective communication, and timely completion of project-related tasks. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities while providing excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate quotes and process orders, including entering data accurately from a variety of sources into a company's software system.
* Provide support in coordinating project details by working with customers and internal teams to ensure all aspects of the project are addressed.
* Coordinate RFQ (Request for Quotation) and project information with the sales team, vendors, factory, and managers.
* Perform customer service tasks in a polite, professional, and friendly manner.
* Assist in special projects as needed under the Project Manager's direction.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Possess a minimum of 3 years of customer service experience.
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions in a manner consistent with the essential job functions.
* Demonstrate proficiency in MS Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Possess strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively as a team player.
* Demonstrate the ability to multitask regularly and meet deadlines.
* Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrate resourcefulness, initiative, and a professional and mature attitude.
* Possess strong project management skills.

**Preferred:**

* Possess experience in the hospitality industry.

**Job Overview**

As a Project Coordinator, you’ll keep projects organized and moving forward by coordinating schedules, maintaining accurate records, and supporting clear communication with clients and colleagues. You’ll also help manage day-to-day office needs, respond to inquiries, and keep project information easy to access. Your impact: By keeping timelines, records, and communications on track, you help project teams stay focused and clients receive timely, organized support.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, project schedules, and follow-up tasks.
* Enter and update project data, maintain spreadsheets, and organize digital and paper files.
* Support office management, front desk coverage, multi-line phone systems, and customer service.
* Prepare documents using word processing and productivity software; assist with routine clerical and administrative tasks.
* Communicate with clients and team members, provide customer support, and handle calls with professional phone etiquette.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail and reliable typing and data entry.
* Computer literacy and technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and other productivity software; QuickBooks experience is useful.
* Office experience, including administrative or clerical work, filing, front desk duties, and phone communication.
* Customer service and client communication skills; experience with multi-line phone systems is preferred.
* Personal assistant experience and calendar management are helpful. Bilingual ability is a plus; it is not required.

Pay: $26.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Reporting to the Director of Student and Alumni Programs of the UCLA Ziman Institute for Real Estate and Urban Economics (ZI), the Program and Operations Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting the execution of the Ziman Institute's major programs and events as well as marketing, course support, and general office operations. Major duties for this position will include: major event coordination and data management support for Ziman-supported student programs (Anderson, Undergrad, Law) and outreach programs (Levine Programs, Housing as Health Care, and Research); Faculty and course support for Ziman UCLA Anderson real estate curriculum courses; digital marketing including website editorial management and maintenance, social media management, and Ziman partner marketing requests; business transaction support, including processing non-employee reimbursements and serving as purchasing system back-up; office management; and administrative support to the Ziman Institute's Faculty Director. Programs and events will primarily be on-campus, however this may also include coordination of off-site events. Members of the Ziman Institute team assign short and long-term tasks on a daily basis. The incumbent must be able to independently prioritize tasks, plan, monitor progress and check quality; apply working knowledge of University policy and procedures; and exhaust creativity and resourcefulness to fulfill assignments as instructed. Independent interpretation, anticipation and problem-solving are required. * Excellent writing and editing skills to compose and proof professional level copy for e-mails, letters, proposals, briefings, invitations, announcements, website, as assigned. (Required)

* Demonstrated high level of analytical and creative problem-solving skills, highly efficient and organized. (Required)

* Demonstrated skill prioritizing multiple assignments and achieving high productivity and work quality under rigid deadlines in a fast-paced environment, skill coordinating large scale, high profile, complex conferences and events. (Required)

* Ability to make independent judgement based on professional and academic expertise beyond the implementation of administratively proscribed rules, policies and guidelines. (Required)

* General knowledge and familiarity with constituent databases, e-mail marketing systems, and UCLA Purchasing systems. (Preferred)

* Demonstrated interpersonal skills and ability to interact in an appropriate professional manner with persons of various ages and social, cultural, economic and educational backgrounds. Excellent interpersonal skills and proven ability to interact in an appropriate manner. (Required)

* Demonstrated ability to work independently in fulfilling various tasks and completing assignments. (Required)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator I (Office of the Young Child - Mental Health Consultation Program)
jobs.description:
The City of Pasadena is currently seeking a Program Coordinator I who will work directly with Early Care and Education professionals, children, and families in the cities of Pasadena, Altadena, and Sierra Madre to provide targeted mental health consultation services to young children exhibiting social-emotional challenges. The Program Coordinator I will conduct weekly classroom observations in Early Care and Education (ECE) settings and lead focused debrief sessions with educators, children, and families. The Program Coordinator I will also conduct training with Early Care and Education professionals to meet the complex behavioral and emotional needs of young children.
  
  
The current vacancy is in the Office of the Young Child under the City Manager's Office.
  
  
**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
  
The *ideal candidate* for this position will possess expertise in early childhood mental health consultation or family support to manage the administrative and programmatic operations of the Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health Consultation Program, including conducting classroom observations and using findings to support staff, children, and families. Ideally, the successful candidate will also possess a Master's degree in psychology, social work, counseling or a related field with at least one year of experience in a clinical setting.
  
  
A licensed mental health professional is desired, but not required.
  
  
**This is a limited term, grant-funded position with current funding to October 2028. Current and future employment is dependent on available funding.**

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

The major responsibilities of this position are listed.

* Plans, organizes, directs and evaluates the daily operations of the Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health Consultation Program; conducts classroom observations to assess classroom culture, daily routines, parent, staff and peer relationships, transitions, challenging behaviors and uses findings to support staff, child and family.
* Partners with consultees to support ongoing communication with caregivers about mental health, behavioral health, or developmental concerns related to their infant or young child.
* Develops written intervention strategies using a team approach to assist staff with positive behavior-support strategies to promote infants’ and young children’s optimal social-emotional development.
* Provides group and individual training on overall social and emotional wellness with specific topics related to infant and early childhood development, trauma-informed care, attachment, self-care, and other related topics.
* Evaluates program needs and develops an effective program; develops procedures within areas of responsibility and instruction materials to assist in accomplishing program goals.
* Develops and/or facilitates trainings and workshops on a range of early childhood mental health topics for consultation, such as typical development, social and emotional skills, problem solving, and preventing or managing challenging behaviors through co-regulation skills.
* Develops a mental health consultation model that is strength-based, culturally-affirming, and trauma-informed.
* Conducts consistent and ongoing consultation meetings/conversations, observations, assessments, and other consultative/therapeutic activities; as assigned performs special tasks involved in responding to an emergency event
* Uses a framework of promotion, prevention, and early intervention to promote mental health and resilience and prevent behavioral problems.
* Demonstrates sensitivity to linguistic, cultural, social, economic, individual, and role differences among the infants, young children, and families served.
* Develops effective public participation strategies and activities and establishes effective working relationships with community groups or representatives, or related agencies; makes presentations to community groups or participates on committees and task forces to interpret/exchange information and to assure cooperation in achieving goals.
* Performs activities necessary to facilitate development of City and community partnerships and collaborative efforts; provides staff support to community-based planning coalitions and committees.
* Prepares analytical papers, publications, newsletters, planning documents and administrative reports; assists in the development of goals, objectives, policies and procedures.
* Conducts needs assessments, research and analyzes statistical and other data; makes recommendations on administrative and operational problems, policies and procedures.
* Assists in the recruitment and selection of interns and volunteers; represents the City in the community and at interdepartmental, interagency and professional meetings.

**Qualification Guidelines**
----------------------------

**COMPETENCIES**
  
The following list represents the core competencies needed for success in this position.

* **Teamwork** - Collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
* **Involving Others** - Engaging others for input, contribution, and shared responsibility for outcomes.
* **Relationship Building** - Establishing rapport and maintaining mutually productive relationships.
* **Self- Management** - Showing personal organization, self-discipline, and dependability Maintaining emotional stability and self-control under pressure, challenge, or adversity.
* **Presentation Skills**- Formally delivering information to groups.
* **Writing-** Communicating effectively in writing.

  
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
  
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for acceptable job performance would qualify. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating digital advertising campaigns, maintaining brand website content, supporting product launches and promotional activities, preparing marketing performance reports, and collaborating with internal teams, external agencies, and brand partners to ensure marketing initiatives are executed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. The Digital Marketing Coordinator supports the day-to-day execution and coordination of digital marketing, e-commerce, and brand marketing initiatives across Philips, Skyworth, and Panasonic TV brands in North America. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, organized, and capable of managing multiple projects in a fast paced environment. This role provides essential executional and operational support to the Senior Marketing Specialist, helping maintain consistent marketing activities and effective collaboration across brands, channels, and stakeholders.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Digital Advertising & Retail Media Support

* Support digital advertising campaigns across Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
* Monitor campaign spending, pacing, performance metrics, and product availability, flagging issues for follow-up.
* Coordinate campaign updates, budget adjustments, creative asset submissions, and promotional changes with agency partners.
* Maintain advertising calendars, campaign trackers, budget records, and performance dashboards.
* Compile weekly and monthly advertising reports and follow up with agencies on campaign performance, deliverables, and optimization updates.
* Assist with implementing approved media plans and campaign adjustments.

Brand Website Content Management

* Maintain and update Philips, Skyworth, and Panasonic brand websites for the North American market.
* Ensure website content is accurate, up to date, consistent with approved brand guidelines, and aligned with product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate with Marketing, Product, and Creative teams to collect assets, confirm product information, and implement content updates.
* Support new product page development, campaign landing pages, product launch updates, and seasonal content refreshes.
* Conduct regular website audits to identify outdated content, broken links, missing assets, and other errors.
* Assist with basic website SEO initiatives, including page titles, metadata, descriptions, internal linking, and content optimization to improve organic visibility.
* Monitor website functionality and user experience, escalating technical issues, and coordinating resolutions with relevant teams or external website partners.

Performance Reporting & Analysis

* Collect and organize advertising, website traffic, and social media performance data from internal reports, agency dashboards, and digital platforms.
* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing performance reports and maintain accurate tracking files.
* Monitor key metrics, including advertising spend, ROAS, attributed sales, conversion rate, impressions, clicks, website traffic, and engagement.
* Flag significant performance changes, budget pacing issues, and other concerns for further review.
* Assist with competitive research, campaign analysis, and performance benchmarking to support marketing planning.

Social Media Management

* Maintain active social media pages across relevant platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Schedule and publish approved content in alignment with marketing calendars, product launches, promotional campaigns, and brand initiatives.
* Adapt existing creative assets for different social media platforms.
* Monitor comments and messages, escalating customer inquiries or issues as needed.
* Track social media performance, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, and video views, and identify opportunities to improve content performance.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in marketing, digital marketing, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 2 years of experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, or brand marketing coordination.
* Hands-on experience supporting digital advertising or retail media campaigns on one or more platforms, such as Walmart Connect, Amazon Ads, Google Ads, or Meta Ads.
* Experience updating website content through a content management system (CMS), such as product pages or campaign landing pages.
* Ability to compile and interpret campaign, website, and social media performance data and prepare recurring reports.
* Experience scheduling and publishing content across major social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn)
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills for collaborating with internal teams, external agencies, and brand partners.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* digital marketing coordination: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Public Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, please attach a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

The Center for Economic and Social Research (CESR) is seeking a **Public Communications Coordinator** to join its team. As part of our growing communications team, this position will work alongside another Communications Coordinator to support the team’s expanding communications and outreach efforts. The **Public Communications Coordinator** will work with a multidisciplinary team to develop and disseminate resources that promote and enable longitudinal and cross-country analyses on aging, health, and retirement, including contextualizing and communicating newly available resources and data on exposures over the lifespan that increase dementia and other disease risk. This position requires a curious communicator who can learn, distill, and disseminate complex, technical information to a wide variety of audiences.

This is a grant funded, one year fixed term position with a hybrid work arrangement.

**Job responsibilities include:**

* Developing and maintaining communications materials
  + Drafting website content and announcements (e.g., newsletters, blogs)
  + Evaluating existing resources and editing content as necessary
  + Reviewing and copy-editing research products (e.g., journal articles, policy briefs, op-eds)
  + Maintaining and growing social media presence (e.g., X, LinkedIn; developing short-form videos or posts)
  + Creating conference and event materials (e.g., brochures/flyers, exhibit posters)
* Distilling complex, technical research topics into clear, concise, and effective content to share with a variety of audiences, both technical and non-technical
* Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure timely completion and distribution of communications materials
* Reviewing and revising project resources and other written materials to ensure quality, readability, and consistency
* Experience or interest in developing a communications strategy to publicize the research project and grow its audience; this may include pitching investigators and other subject matter experts for news articles, media appearances, and op-eds

**Qualifications:**

Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts, make them easily understandable through varied mediums, incorporate feedback, and iteratively refine content.

Ability to collaborate effectively with numerous project stakeholders (e.g., investigators, administrative staff, university officials) at the university and with collaborators at other research institutions. Strong editing skills, ranging from developmental editing to copyediting. Graphic design experience is a plus but not required.

  

Minimum education: Bachelor’s Degree

Minimum Experience: 2+ years (3+ years preferred). Background in communications, public relations, marketing, or a related field is required. A background or experience working in academia or with clients in public health, economics, or policy is not required, but is preferred.

**Work Arrangement:**

Hybrid (3 days per week) on the University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA.

**Compensation**

The hourly rate range for this position is $31.97 - $35.35. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**

The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy & Government Service develops evidence-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.

Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, the USC Schaeffer Institute includes four flagship centers: the Schaeffer Center for Health Policy & Economics, the Center for Economic and Social Research, the Center for Civic Society and the Leonard D. Schaeffer Fellows in Government Service.

The Schaeffer Institute is home to more than 150 scholars and staff, including three Nobel Laureates and seven members of the National Academy of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. Schaeffer experts have testified before numerous Congressional committees and are regularly sought out by media outlets—including the New York Times, NPR, Stat, Wall Street Journal, and Washington Post—to provide insight on policy issues.

The Institute has offices at USC in Los Angeles and at the USC Capital Campus in Washington, DC.

**About the Center for Civic Society at the Schaeffer Institute**

The Center for Civic Society aims to assess, strengthen and promote democratic values around the world through research, civic engagement and global dialogue. Chaired by Former Prime Minister Gordon Brown and led by Anna Saavedra, the Center for Civic Society was launched in 2026 and is dedicated to bridging political, social and economic divides through evidence-based research that informs and promotes better public policy.

**About the Sol Price School of Public Policy**

Ranked among the foremost schools of public policy in the nation, the USC Sol Price School of Public Policy generates uncommon knowledge for the common good. The school is composed of overlapping disciplines that generate innovative approaches to critical issues ranging from health-care policy to homelessness, and sustainability to congestion – to name a few. A wide-ranging curriculum, including extensive experiential learning, prepares our graduates to navigate problems that demand multi-layered solutions driven by critical, informed thinking.

Role:

**About the Role**

Behind every well-organized department is someone who knows how to connect the details, anticipate what's needed, and keep important priorities moving. As the Administrative Coordinator at Southland Credit Union, you'll provide high-level administrative and operational support to our SVP of People & Culture while helping coordinate the projects, communications, and initiatives that support the broader department.

This role combines executive-level administrative support with presentation development, communications, and project coordination. You'll help manage priorities, prepare materials for leadership discussions, organize departmental activities, and ensure important follow-ups don't get lost. Your ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and bring structure to complex details will make you an important resource to the People & Culture team.

  
Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Supporting Leadership and Keeping Priorities Moving**

You'll work closely with the SVP of People & Culture to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, organize leadership materials, and ensure discussions and follow-up items stay on track. You'll also draft and format correspondence, reports, and professional documents while maintaining organized departmental records and resources.

Being effective in this role means knowing how to look ahead. You'll anticipate administrative needs, navigate scheduling conflicts, manage competing priorities, and use good judgment when handling sensitive employee and organizational information. From coordinating appointments to tracking outstanding assignments, your organization and follow-through will help keep departmental priorities moving.

**Turning Information Into Clear, Professional Communications**

You'll use your organizational and creative skills to develop polished, executive-ready presentations, reports, and supporting materials for leadership discussions, departmental meetings, employee training, and organizational initiatives. You'll take information and data and translate them into clear, visually engaging materials that communicate priorities, support decision-making, and keep others informed.

You'll also help shape how People & Culture communicates with associates. This includes preparing employee announcements, newsletters, departmental updates, and informational resources, as well as creating presentation templates and maintaining SharePoint pages and intranet content. Whether you're preparing materials for a leadership discussion or helping communicate an employee initiative, accuracy, thoughtful presentation, and attention to detail matter.

**Coordinating the Work Behind People & Culture Initiatives**

People & Culture supports a variety of programs and initiatives that contribute to the associate experience, and you'll help coordinate the details that bring them together. You'll maintain project timelines, trackers, and status updates, follow up on outstanding deliverables, and coordinate logistics, communications, and materials for employee engagement programs, training sessions, recognition activities, and organizational events.

You'll also support the ongoing work of the department by helping prepare and maintain HR policies, procedures, forms, and resources. Compiling information, conducting research, and preparing reports will give the team additional support for planning and decision-making. You'll also assist with administrative responsibilities such as invoice processing, expense reports, purchasing, and budget tracking.

Success in this role means leadership has the organization and support needed to stay focused on priorities, departmental initiatives remain coordinated, and communications and materials are accurate and professionally prepared. Just as importantly, the people you support can rely on you to anticipate needs, take ownership, and follow through.

**Education**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.

**You'll Be at Your Best in This Role If You:**

* Have experience providing administrative support to senior leadership and understand the preparation, professionalism, and discretion that level of support requires.
* Know how to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and coordinate follow-up without needing every next step outlined.
* Communicate professionally and confidently, including when preparing correspondence and materials for leadership audiences.
* Have strong presentation design, document formatting, and written communication skills.

* Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing projects, deadlines, and assignments independently.

* Are proactive, resourceful, adaptable, and interested in finding ways to improve administrative processes.

Your future mirrors the limitless possibilities of our future. Join us at Andersen, and together, let's write the story of your success!

The Role:

The Operations Coordinator supports the day-to-day operations of the office, helping maintain an organized, professional, and efficient workplace. This role provides support across office services, facilities, vendors, meetings and events, and tax-processing activities. The ideal candidate is proactive, highly organized, service-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with accuracy and professionalism.

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Office Operations & Facilities**

* Conduct daily office walkthroughs to ensure common areas, kitchens, conference rooms, and workspaces are organized, stocked, and ready for use.
* Maintain inventory and replenish office supplies, snacks, beverages, and other workplace necessities.
* Monitor office requests, deliveries, building issues, and maintenance needs.
* Coordinate repairs, maintenance, vendor access, loading dock and freight elevator reservations with building management.
* Support office moves, furniture and equipment deliveries, workspace changes, and storage organization.

**Mail & Office Services**

* Receive, sort, track, and distribute USPS, FedEx, UPS, courier, certified mail, and other deliveries.
* Coordinate outgoing mail, packages, and time-sensitive shipments.
* Assist service lines with tax-return packaging, shipping, and related administrative needs.

**Meetings, Events & Busy Season Support**

* Coordinate food and beverage orders for meetings, trainings, office events, and other programs.
* Prepare conference and training rooms, including seating, materials, supplies, catering, and coordination of technology needs.
* Coordinate busy season lunches and dinners, including ordering, scheduling, delivery, setup, and vendor communication.
* Provide logistical support for office events and employee initiatives.

**Vendors, Invoices & Expenses**

* Communicate with vendors regarding services, scheduling, deliveries, invoices, and upcoming work.
* Review and process vendor invoices and supporting documentation.
* Track office expenses, purchases, budgets, and applicable charge codes.
* Maintain vendor records, Certificates of Insurance (COIs), contracts, service information, and other operational documentation.
* Assist with vendor contracts and renewals as needed.

**Tax Processing & E-File Support**

* Track client e-file authorization forms from distribution through receipt.
* Follow up with engagement teams regarding outstanding client e-file forms.
* Assist with the electronic release of tax returns and extensions to applicable tax authorities.
* Monitor electronically filed returns and extensions for acceptance or rejection and communicate status to engagement teams.
* Assist with rejected filings and other e-file issues as needed.
* Track office-wide client tax return deadlines and filing statuses and communicate updates to tax teams.
* Maintain accurate and confidential tax-processing records and tracking tools.

**General Support**

* Respond to employee requests and provide timely follow-up on operational matters.
* Maintain accurate records, trackers, files, and operational documentation.
* Assist with special projects and other duties as assigned.

Construction company is a growing design-build and general contracting company specializing in high-end residential remodeling, additions, ADUs, and new construction throughout the Los Angeles area.

We are looking for an experienced In-House SEO & Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our SEO, website performance, local search presence, paid search campaigns, analytics, and digital lead-generation strategy.

Technical SEO

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking. **Properly track phone calls, contact forms, booked appointments, and other important conversion events.** Build dashboards and reports covering organic traffic and rankings, leads by source, cost per lead, conversion rates, Google Ads performance, local/Google Maps performance, website performance, lead quality, and ROI. **Go beyond reporting numbers—we expect this person to explain what is working, what isn't, why, and what we should do next.**

* Understand Reddit culture, subreddit rules, and proper community engagement. **Identify opportunities to build organic brand visibility without spam or overly promotional posting.** Participate strategically in relevant construction, remodeling, homeowner, and local communities. **Identify additional forums, Q&A sites, Facebook/community groups, and online communities where our target customers are active.**

jobs.title: Retail Operations Coordinator - West
jobs.description:
*Twenty years ago, Les Composantes began with a selection of vintage pieces, born from a desire for creative independence and an eye for detail. That instinct and an appreciation for design that endures have shaped everything that followed.*

*From there, Sézane was born in Paris in 2013. Since then, la famille has continued to grow, with Octobre Éditions for men, Les Composantes reimagined as a home and lifestyle destination, and Petit Sézane for children.*

*Our story has unfolded like life itself: through instinct, spontaneity, and learning. We developed a singular approach to detail, service, and connection. A way of imagining a Parisian wardrobe for real life, first online and later through our Appartements. From day one, we have been guided by a commitment to making beautiful design accessible, without ever compromising on quality.*

To continue to co-construct the next chapter and beyond, we are looking for creative, organized and agile talents, who share our passion to perpetually improve all that can be.

Care to imagine what comes next with us? We can’t wait to hear from you!

We are seeking the talents of a **Retail Operations Coordinator - West** to join our Retail Ops Team. This role is based in our West Hollywood office and requires regular domestic travel.

The Retail Operations Coordinator helps drive smooth day-to-day store operations and contributes to a cohesive, on-brand experience for Sézane customers and internal teams. This role prioritizes inventory accuracy, efficient operational execution, facilities coordination, and alignment of processes across Sézane’s West Coast retail fleet, working closely with Store Directors and cross-functional teams.

Reporting to the Retail Operations Manager US, the ideal candidate brings a blend of precision, analytical thinking, and adaptability, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves on tasks ranging from stockroom management and reporting to maintenance coordination, process implementation, and store technology.

**About the Role**

**Facilities & Maintenance**

* Serve alongside the Retail Operations Manager as a key point of contact for West Coast store maintenance requests, ensuring timely resolution and reliable communication with store teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, including obtaining and reviewing quotes, supporting vendor negotiations, scheduling work, and tracking projects through completion in partnership with the Retail Operations Manager.
* Support the day-to-day management of maintenance framework contracts and vendor relationships, monitoring costs, service levels, and adherence to agreed scopes and pricing.
* Assist in ensuring West Coast stores meet OSHA, ADA, fire, and applicable local safety and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate and schedule preventive maintenance for West Coast stores, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire safety, and other building systems, as well as maintenance needs associated with new store openings and renovations.
* Respond to urgent repair needs and support store teams with troubleshooting guidance, escalating as appropriate to the Retail Operations Manager.
* Monitor maintenance spend and quotes to help identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining appropriate service and brand standards.
* Ensure facilities maintain a clean, safe, functional, and brand-appropriate customer and employee environment.

**Back Office & Inventory Operations**

* Support daily, weekly, and monthly inventory operations across West Coast retail locations, including cycle counts and annual store inventories.
* Partner with HQ Logistics and store teams to ensure timely and accurate inventory movements, including inbound shipments, transfers, and outbound shipments/RTVs.
* Develop strong working knowledge of Sézane's retail, inventory, and planning tools and systems, serving as an operational resource for store teams and supporting troubleshooting and process adoption.
* Assist with inventory-related training materials, SOPs, and store communications.
* Support inventory processes during new store openings, store closures, system implementations, and special projects.
* Support the coordination and animation of the US stockist community, sharing best practices, operational updates, and tools to promote consistent stockroom standards across the network.

**Front of House Operations**

* Ensure customer-facing operational processes are consistent, efficient, and aligned with brand standards, including assisting with the creation and implementation of scalable SOPs and operational projects.
* Monitor key Customer Experience and operational KPIs, including guest rate, opt-in rate, mobile checkout rate, web orders, and other relevant metrics, helping identify trends and coordinate action plans with store teams and the Retail Operations Manager.
* Act as a point of contact for POS-related issues, escalations, and troubleshooting.
* Assist with onboarding and training store teams on POS enhancements, new tools, and operational workflows.
* Monitor store technology and devices, including iPads, scanners, printers, routers, and charging stations, and coordinate the replacement of outdated or damaged equipment.
* Monitor developments in retail technology and operational tools, benchmarking potential solutions and proposing opportunities to improve or digitize store operations.
* Participate in cross-functional Task Forces and special projects with Retail, IT, Logistics, Planning, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to support operational improvements and new initiatives.

**Store Visits & Reporting**

* Conduct structured 360° store visits across the West Coast fleet, assessing facilities, inventory, back-of-house operations, customer experience, technology, and overall operational standards, with clear reporting on observations, opportunities, and action items.
* Maintain a regular store visit cadence, with an expected minimum of once per month for LA locations and every two months

jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator: Grocery & Food Rescue**

**Position Description**

**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Status:** Full-Time, Hourly, Non-Exempt, $27.83 - $29.37/hour (DOE)

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 40 hours/week, Hybrid: in-office 3 days & remote 2 days

**Benefits**: We offer excellent Benefit Plans including incremental PTO Plan; 15 + Paid Holidays plus a Birthday Floating Holiday. 403b retirement plan with a match. Medical, Vision & Dental insurance plans with majority paid by employer. Life Insurance plan and Employee Assistance Program paid by employer.

Would you like to go to work knowing that every day you’ll be making a real difference in the lives of at-risk people in your community? At Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County that’s exactly what you’ll be doing. Every moment of your workday will directly impact our mission to provide food for those who need it, when they need it. **Come join our upbeat, collaborative team who are improving lives every day by taking hunger off the table.**

**POSITION PURPOSE:** The role of the Program Coordinator is to manage the Grocery Rescue Program and Food Rescue donations. The primary objective of this position is to coordinate all Partner Network aspects of these food donation programs to ensure food-insecure individuals, families and students are being provided fresh, nutritious food at locations throughout Orange County.

The Grocery Rescue (GR) Program involves extensive coordination and support of our 75+ partners that pick-up food donations from 250+ local grocery stores via 900+ pick-ups each week. The GR Program is carried out in collaboration with our Food Sourcing Department and the food donors they partner with. Each month, nearly 40% of all food distributed by SHFB partners is acquired through the GR Program.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Grocery Rescue Program**

* Oversee all aspects of coordinating the Grocery Rescue Program in collaboration with the GR Program Coordinator and Supervisor, and as detailed in the GR Program manual.
* Primarily work with a portfolio of 40+ GR partners.
* Coordinate grocery store pick-up schedules with each partner and in collaboration with the SHFB Sourcing Department. Ensure all needed grocery store pick-ups are covered, or work with other SHFB departments to determine a solution.
* Troubleshoot GR partner challenges or store concerns as they arise. Follow feedback procedure.
* Ensure all GR pickup poundage receipts are submitted each week by all GR partners within assigned portfolio. Carry out corrective action procedures for late or missed reporting, as needed.
* Proactively look for anomalies in the data and seek answers from partners to address concerns.
* Develop, maintain, and cultivate new and existing Grocery Rescue partnerships.
* Train and supervise partners in assigned portfolio. Set proper expectations for program operations to ensure the program is always carried out by partner staff and volunteers.
* Conduct annual GR partner training and additional training as needed.
* Ensure partner compliance with program rules and regulations, as detailed in the Grocery Rescue Program Agreement – including food safety and reporting requirements.
* Carry out new GR partner onboarding processes.
* Conduct compliance site visits at GR partner locations, as assigned.
* Provide ongoing support to GR partners via email, phone calls and in-person or Zoom meetings as needed.
* Ensure all Program information in documents, files, and spreadsheets are kept up to date.
* Proactively look for solutions to partner challenges in executing the GR program. Including providing guidance and/or working with SHFB Sourcing department to overcome obstacles.
* Proactively look for ways to continuously improve the Grocery Rescue Program, including its effectiveness and how to better meet the needs of our partners.
* Demonstrate Service Excellence and Integrity when carrying out all aspects of program management.
* Actively participate in weekly team meetings and report updates, concerns, and successes in group meetings and at 1:1s.
* Attend webinars and trainings to increase food bank, food & nutritional insecurity, and Feeding America knowledge.
* Assist in collecting client stories for Grant Reports and various Development Department needs.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:**

* Ability to lift 25-50 pounds to carry equipment and supplies as needed.
* Regular driving throughout Orange County.
* Extended periods of sitting working on computer or on phone.
* Indoor office environment, indoor warehouse environment with moderate noise at food bank location.
* Up to 25% of time spent off-site at Community Partner locations and attending various meetings.
* Office hours are 8am – 4:30pm, but schedule varies based on department needs. Possible evening and weekend hours.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bilingual English/Spanish required (written and verbal).
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience.
* Must have prior professional experience in non-profit, program coordination, or grocery retail.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* A professional who is reliable, proactive communicator and actively engaged member of the team.
* Self-starter with the ability, confidence, and good judgment to move projects forward with minimal supervision from direct Supervisor.
* Nurture strong professional relationships with coworkers, partners – current and potential, and external stakeholders.
* Excellent professional verbal and written communication skills. Communicate comprehensively with direct supervisors and the Director of Programs & Services on an on-going basis.
* Proven experience using logical reasoning to identify areas for improvement and to problem solve. Proactive about seeking solutions to meet program, partner, and team goals.
* Dedication to continuous improvement and experience with making changes that lead to improved results

The role supports Anduril's Connected Warfare division which builds the software, computing hardware, and networks that connect people, sensors, and autonomous systems across land, sea, air, and space. ### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (Health)
jobs.description:
Tustin, CA

H - Business – H - Business /

On-site

  

**The Company**

VeSync is a portfolio company with brands that cover different categories of health & wellness products. We wouldn't be surprised if you have one of our Levoit air purifiers in your living room or a COSORI air fryer whipping up healthy and delicious meals for you every night.

We're a young and energetic company, we've had tremendous success, and we are constantly growing our team. As we garner more industry attention — just check out our accomplishments and awards by CES Innovation, iF Design, IGA, and Red Dot — we also need driven and talented people to join our team.

That brings us to you, and what you'll be joining. Our teams are smart and diligent and take ownership of their work — they're confident in their work but know how to collaborate with open ears and a spirit of learning. If you're down-to-earth, approachable, and easy to strike up a conversation with, this may be a great fit for you.

  

**Check out our other brands**:

levoit.com | cosori.com | etekcity.com

  

**The Opportunity**

A new ecosystem at the intersection of wellness and technology, with a connected product, hardware and software, built to help people take an active role in their own health rather than simply measure it. The Social Media Manager owns the social presence behind that launch, from the first post through the audience we build.

Your job is to decide what each channel is for, build the content that fills it, and grow an audience from a standing start. You'll set the strategy and make the work, engage the people who show up, and build the credibility that turns attention into members. We are pre-launch, and the brand, the positioning, and the claims we can make are all still being built. You'll work alongside that, not after it. It's a hands-on role.

### **What you will do at VeSync:**

**Channel Strategy & Audience**

* **Own the Channel Strategy**: Define what each channel is for, the role it plays from first impression through consideration, and the goal it carries. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, Reddit, and what comes next.
* **Own the Audience Build**: Grow the audience from a standing start. Audience and engagement growth are numbers you own, with an approach behind them.
* **Turn Positioning into Channel-Native Content**: Take the positioning and claims framework owned by Product Marketing and turn it into content that works on each channel, adapted rather than copied across. Both are being written now, so expect to work from drafts and adjust as they settle.

**Content & Voice**

* **Own the Calendar and the Formats**: Build the programming calendar, the repeatable formats behind it, and the production cadence that keeps it fed.
* **Make the Work**: Concept, write, shoot, edit, and publish. Creative and agency partners support you, they don't do it for you.
* **Hold the Voice and the Claims Line**: Keep a consistent brand voice across channels, and work inside the medical, regulatory, and claims review process rather than around it.

**Engagement & Performance**

* **Drive Engagement on Owned Channels**: Reply to comments, answer DMs, and take part in the conversation under our own posts. Route product issues and escalations to CX.
* **Show Up on Reddit and in Forums**: Hold our presence in the places this product gets discussed by people who know it well. These are spaces we don't control, and they reward participation over promotion.
* **Own the Numbers**: Set the metrics and KPIs for each channel, report performance honestly, and turn what the data says into what gets made next.

### **What you bring to the role:**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree required.
* **Experience**: 5+ years managing social media for consumer (B2C) brands, with hands-on direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience. Health & wellness, consumer hardware, and subscription or membership backgrounds are strongly preferred.
* **New Brand & Audience Build**: Proven track record launching a brand, sub-brand, or product line into an audience that did not previously exist.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity**: Can build while the brand, the positioning, and the claims framework are still being settled. Makes progress on partial information, changes direction when decisions land, and doesn't fill the gaps by inventing positioning of their own.
* **Platform Native**: Fluent in the craft and the culture of each channel and in how they differ. Comfortable in forums and communities you don't control, where publishing like a brand doesn't work.
* **Hands-On Maker**: Concepts, writes, shoots, and edits. Produces the content, not only the brief.
* **Claims & Regulatory Fluency**: Experience in health, wellness, medical device, supplements, or a similarly regulated space. Knows what to avoid, and how to say something true and interesting inside real constraints.
* **Analytical**: Sets metrics and KPIs, reads performance honestly, and uses it to decide what to make next. Able to argue engagement quality over vanity metrics and back it with evidence.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Partners closely with paid social, brand and creative, product, and CX.

### **Location:**

* This is an on-site, office-based role in Tustin, CA.

### **Salary:**

* Starting at $90K Annually

### **Perks and Benefits:**

* 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for employee AND spouse + dependents!
* 401K with 4% employer match (eligible after 90 days of employment) and immediate vesting
* Generous PTO policy + paid holidays
* Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Critical Illness Coverage
* Accident Insurance
* Healthcare FSA
* Dependent Care FSA
* Travel Assistance Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Fully stocked kitchen

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:

We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  
  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  
  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  
  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

  

We're looking for a ***Continuous Improvement Operations Coordinator*** to support the day-to-day execution of continuous improvement programs and projects, ensuring people, processes, and systems operate smoothly. This role supports operational deliverables, data collection activities, operational readiness efforts, system testing, and team training.

  

You’ll report to the *Director, Continuous Improvement* and **work onsite at our Santa Ana, CA HQ.**

  

**Onsite Requirement:**

This role requires you to be onsite in the office 5 days per week.

  

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Daily operational execution** : Support the delivery of continuous improvement initiatives and operational priorities to ensure execution remains on track.
* **Data collection support:** Assist with data collection activities, including procurement, batching, and coordinating work assignments for temporary staff.
* **Operational readiness:** Help prepare people, processes, materials, and work areas to support new operational launches and process changes.
* **System testing:** Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validate system enhancements prior to implementation.
* **Training** : Train team members on operational processes, equipment, standard work, and workflows.

*Batch & Data Collection Operations:*

* Create and maintain procurement trackers and provide regular updates on procurement status and progress.
* Keep work areas stocked with required operational supplies and materials.
Monitor inventory levels and coordinate replenishment activities to avoid operational disruptions.  

  

**Who You Are:**

* 3 years of experience in operations, coordination, project support, or a related field, ideally within a production, fulfillment, logistics, or manufacturing environment.
* Experience directing, scheduling, or coordinating the work of others, including temporary or cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to UAT, process validation, or structured system testing preferred.
* Strong organizational and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Clear communicator capable of training team members and coordinating across operational and technical teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, spreadsheets, and basic reporting.
Continuous improvement mindset with strong problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.  

  

**Physical Requirements:**

* **Hand Use** : Regular hand use for various tasks
* **Hearing Requirements:** Ability to hear alarms, signals, and verbal instructions
* **Lifting and Carrying:** Ability to lift, carry, and move materials up to 40 pounds
* **Phone Answering:** Talking on the phone and texting may be required, as well as manual dexterity to operate a computer and phone system efficiently
* **Sitting or Standing** : Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time

  

**Hourly Range:**

*The hourly range for this position is $27-$32. Actual compensation in this range will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including location, job level, prior experience, and skill set.*

  

**Reasons To Join Us:**

* Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision
* Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits
* 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to our employees to support their future financial goals

Fun Working Environment: Our team members are invited to participate in celebrations, holiday events, and team building activities

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Workplace Relocations & Events
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites

**Employment type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based

**Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates

**Reports to:** Founder

**Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow floor plans, labeling systems and checklists.
* Clear communication with movers, building staff, client employees and project teams.
* Basic proficiency in Google Workspace and comfort learning project tracking tools.
* Availability to attend scheduled moves and events, including evening, overnight and weekend assignments.
* Reliable transportation to client sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Ability to move throughout project sites during extended shifts and perform setup tasks such as posting signage and placing labels, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

**Growth Opportunities**

This role can be a long-term fit for someone who enjoys project coordination, with flexibility for greater responsibility for those interested in advancing.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

**Development & Administrative Coordinator (Full-Time – Hybrid – Richmond, CA)**

**About East Bay Center for the Performing Arts**

For more than 56 years, East Bay Center for the Performing Arts has been a cultural beacon in Richmond, California, engaging children and youth with transformative, tuition-free arts education. Our programs are designed to create safe, rigorous, supportive spaces where young people can explore and express themselves through cross cultural performing arts-catalyzing personal growth, community connection, and social change. Every day, our work at the Center demonstrates the power of art to unite and uplift people of diverse backgrounds and create new ways of seeing the world. East Bay Center serves 4000+ children and youth each year from communities reflective of the city’s demographics: 95% of our students are youth of color, 80% come from low-income families, and 40% are English learners. Through the active creation of original art, we emphasize social justice and the skill, effort, courage, and discipline needed to successfully prepare, create, and perform!

In our next 50 years, we aspire to engage thousands more youth and strengthen our role as a community hub and cultural anchor in Richmond. Despite their importance, affordable, culturally relevant, sequential musical and performing arts training opportunities for youth are scarce in Richmond. The need is clear: schools in our district face significant challenges in securing sufficient funding for the arts, and 90% of CA public schools do not meet state standards for arts education. East Bay Center fills this void through tuition-free, healing-centered performing arts programs at our main site (70+ weekly classes) and sequential arts education in 15 Richmond public schools.

**About the Position**

Under the direction of the Director of Advancement, the Development and Administrative Coordinator (the “Coordinator”) is a key member of the Development Team and works closely with the Individual Giving Manager, Grants Manager and Communications Manager, and will have broad exposure across the full fundraising lifecycle.

The Coordinator owns daily gift entry, tax receipt, and CRM integrity, and tracks the stewardship pipeline that ensures every donor and funder is communicated with, acknowledged, and thanked––supporting the team’s overall efforts to grow and steward our donor base and increase revenue, while also being responsible for development operations functions and database management.

The Coordinator also serves as department lead in optimizing Salesforce, ensuring that data practices and processes are in place to support the annual development plan, including overseeing and assisting with gift processing and tracking, progress reporting, and integration with finance operations.

The Coordinator also provides support across donor events and communications and helps the wider team stay organized and on schedule.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and highly organized, with the judgment to know that clean data and timely thank-yous come first, especially during high-volume periods like year-end, while everything else flexes around that core work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* Execute the timely stewardship pipeline by issuing tax receipts and drafting, printing, and mailing personalized thank-you letters; organize thank-you calls.
* Track stewardship touchpoints in the CRM and Asana, keeping the moves management tracking current for the Individual Giving Manager, Director of Advancement and the Executive Director.
* Maintain accurate donor records in the CRM, including contact information, giving history, and notes from donor interactions; Document donor meetings by gathering, transcribing, and filing notes in individual donor files.
* Assist with creating and updating donor profiles to support cultivation and stewardship.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Event planning and logistics: Handle administrative logistics for fundraising events, including annual Gala, managing RSVP lists, coordinating with vendors, staffing registration desks.
* Team support & reporting: Pull mailing lists and email segments; run wealth screenings and prep donor briefs; organize prospect lists and notes. Pull fundraising revenue reports, donor retention metrics, and campaign performance data as requested by department leadership.
* Communications support: Support the Communications Manager with segmented list pulls, social media scheduling and posting, and proofreading of donor-facing materials and appeals.

* Strong commitment to the Center’s mission, constituency and community
* Solid industry knowledge of fundraising processes, protocols and procedures
* Experience with all areas of direct response fundraising, including direct mail and digital appeals, social media and website fundraising.
* Track record of meeting revenue projections and staying within budget.
* Experience managing external vendors and suppliers.
* Outstanding communication skills, both written orally.
* Ability to influence and negotiate with colleagues and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail and documenting projects, activities and outcomes.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to meet internal and external deadlines.

About Speech Goals

Speech Goals is a privately owned pediatric therapy practice serving children and families throughout San Francisco and the Peninsula. We specialize in early intervention, family-centered care, and collaborative, interdisciplinary support for young children and their caregivers.

We believe meaningful growth happens through connection, play, and developmentally appropriate experiences. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating positive, meaningful opportunities for the children and families we serve.

We are excited to expand our programs to include inclusive, community-centered playgroups where children of all abilities can explore, connect, build friendships, and learn through play!

Our goal is to create welcoming environments that celebrate individuality, encourage natural social interactions, and give children opportunities to experience the joy of playing alongside their peers.

Our administrative teams play a critical role in supporting Speech Goals' programs and operations across locations, ensuring families, therapists, and clinical teams receive the coordination and support they need.

* Proactively identify potential authorization issues or administrative barriers and escalate them before they impact scheduled services.

3. Documentation & Report Coordination

* Communicate proactively with therapists and supervisors regarding approaching deadlines and missing information.

* Track outstanding referral requirements and follow up with families or referral sources as needed.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convey**
----------------

Every growing company runs on an invisible operating layer: recurring work that crosses a dozen systems and still needs a person to move it forward. Convey is a digital workforce platform. We take that work off the team and give it to digital teammates that the company's own operators train and manage. Each teammate owns a responsibility from the first request to the finished result.

Customers like TelevisaUnivision, Savoya, and Strategus use Convey for work that stands between the business and its revenue. Strategus cut integration launches from three to six months down to under one week.

**About the role**
------------------

We sell to executives, and you'll create the rooms where they meet us. You'll own Convey's field events and event speaking opportunities, and make them the in-person engine of our account-based motion: executive dinners and roundtables, our own events, and the right presence at the right industry events. Working hand in hand with sales, you'll make sure every event starts from our target accounts and ends in meetings and pipeline.

You'll also build the team differently. Alongside the core job, you'll train and manage your own digital workforce on Convey. Those teammates will own the recurring research, tracking, and follow-up work that usually takes over a field marketer's week, so your time goes to strategy, experiences, and relationships. You'll be customer zero for the product you're marketing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Event strategy and budget**

* Build and own the field events plan and budget, chosen around where our target accounts and executive buyers actually gather.
* Decide where we show up and how: sponsorships, hosted side events, booths, or not at all.

**Executive and hosted events**

* Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, and workshops around key industry events and in our priority markets.
* Create events we host ourselves, from small executive gatherings to customer and community events.

**Speaking opportunities**

* Source, pitch, and secure speaking slots for our executives and customers at events that reach our buyers. Partner with brand marketing on each executive's point of view and talk.
* Turn every talk into conversations with target accounts.

**Account-based execution**

* Partner with account executives and demand generation to build invite lists from target accounts, and run the outreach before each event and the follow-up after.
* Own the handoff: every attendee conversation reaches the right seller quickly, with context.

**Measurement**

* Track every event from invite to pipeline: target account attendance, meetings, and pipeline sourced and influenced. Report on it every week and cut what doesn't work.
* Keep event data clean in the CRM and marketing platforms.

**Vendors and logistics**

* Manage venues, agencies, production, swag, travel, and budgets, with the same bar for a 12-person dinner as for a 2,000-person conference.

At Cube, we're redefining how organizations deliver, consume, and automate data and analytics across teams, tools, and AI agents. Our mission is to enable Agentic Analytics, where AI agents work alongside humans on a shared semantic foundation

If you're fascinated by building core data and AI infrastructure, the kind that powers analytics at the world's most advanced technology companies, but want the agility and ownership of a startup, Cube is where you'll thrive.

With 19,000+ GitHub stars and 13,000+ community members, Cube is trusted by 400+ companies, including Maersk, Kimberly-Clark, Freshworks, Patagonia, Webflow, Brex, Deel, Tubi, Walmart, and Drata. Our platform empowers AI agents with a universal semantic foundation, enabling autonomous analytics at scale while maintaining consistency, security, and performance across BI tools, spreadsheets, and embedded applications.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success Manager who can operate at the intersection of data engineering and business strategy. This is not a traditional CSM role where you send check-in emails and track NPS scores. You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

jobs.description:
Operations Assistant (4722C), Institute for Research on Labor & Employment - #89813 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The UC Berkeley Labor Center conducts research and education on issues related to labor and employment. The Labor Center's curricula and leadership training serve to educate a diverse new generation of labor leaders. The Labor Center carries out policy relevant research on topics such as job quality and workforce development, and works with unions, policymakers and other stakeholders to develop innovative policy perspectives and programs. The Labor Center provides an important source of research and information on unions and the changing workforce for students, scholars, policymakers and the public. This position offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a high-impact, high-visibility organization and to work with a nationally-recognized team of researchers, policy analysts, and educators. We have nearly 40 diverse staff members.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Operations Assistant reports to the Director of Operations and performs a variety of moderately complex to difficult administrative tasks to support the Labor Center, and if needed, will also support individual programs/teams. The position regularly works on tasks that are varied and complex, applies the full range of specialized skills and job knowledge, frequently adapts procedures, techniques, tools, materials, and/or equipment to meet specialized needs, performs broad and/or focused assignments under general supervision, and relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish assigned tasks.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Staff and Academic Search Coordination - 25%
  
  
With direction from the Director of Operations, coordinate selected phases of the staff and non-senate academic search and appointment process to include, but not limited to, ad placement, documentation collection, updating AP Recruit and TAM, and conducting search closure activities.
  
  
Student-Employee Recruitment and Hiring - 25%
  
  
With direction from the Director of Operations and collaboration with SHARE HR, coordinate student-employee recruitment & hiring process to include but not limited to: collect appointment information; complete IRLE Hiring Smartsheet; complete MLA and Fee Remission Transfer forms; create and distribute Reader/Tutor appointment letters. Be an information resource for students and hiring managers
  
  
Travel and Reimbursement Coordination - 15%
  
  
Coordinate travel and reimbursement activities for Center staff, students, and guests.
  
  
Student Stipend and Honorarium Processing - 10%

**Job Title:** Gender Affirming Care Fund Project Coordinator
  
**Department:** Gender Affirming Care
