**Created Date:** 11/5/2026
  
**Revised Date:** 11/5/2026
  
**Salary:** $97,195 annually
  
**FLSA Classification:** Exempt
  
  
Who We Are
  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
 Our Culture
  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.
  
  
About The Role
  
The GAC Fund Project Coordinator will work under the direction of the GAC Project Manager to administer the NYC GAC Fund portfolio. The GAC Fund Project Coordinator is part of the team primarily responsible for citywide efforts to promote and protect access to gender affirming care.
  
  
About the Program
  
Gender-affirming care (GAC) is recognized by major U.S. medical associations as medically necessary for many transgender and gender-diverse people. In addition, many transgender and gender non-conforming/non-binary (TGNCNB) individuals also need legal or practical assistance in updating their identification documents, combatting jobs or housing discrimination, or even accessing education or bathrooms. Research shows GAC is associated with reduced depression and suicidal ideation, and better long-term mental health outcomes. Denial of care or legal recognition of one’s identity increases risk of mental health crisis and unsafe self-treatment. Yet access has become increasingly difficult due to state-level restrictions, insurance barriers, and shifting federal guidance.
  
  
New York City has been an innovator and leader in sexual and reproductive health. The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has long followed the tenets of the Sexual and Reproductive Justice Framework which states that all people should have the power and resources to make healthy decisions about their bodies, including sexuality and reproduction.
  
  
As part of these efforts, the Health Department will develop and implement a new fund to contract with clinical providers to ensure access to care for youth in need of gender-affirming care. This funding will enable providers of youth gender-affirming care to address financial shortfalls resulting from any denials or reductions in federal funding and increase their capacity to ensure continuity of care for medically necessary hormone therapy for transgender youth in accessible and affordable care settings.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
**The GAC Fund Project Coordinator will:**  

* Conduct a landscape analysis of the New York City GAC provider network
* Synthesize service level and cost information to create a strategic plan and recommendations for fund administration to identify opportunities for funding.
* Assist with the planning, implementation, coordination and oversight of the contract administration activities for the GAC Fund, including:
* Work with the GAC Fund Project Manager to assist with developing, reviewing, negotiating and managing solicitation and contract-related documents including grant or contract proposals, scopes of work, evaluation criteria, contract amendments and budget modifications
* Collaborate with Finance and Administrative teams to monitor grantee/contractor performance and coordinate and communicate directly with grantee/contractors regarding contract deliverables and operational expectations to support successful contract performance and service delivery.
* Work with the GAC Fund Data Analyst to track grantee/contractor performance through regular review of programmatic data.
* Help with coordinating contractor meetings and execution, including logistics, agenda and content development.
* Serve as primary point of contact for current and prospective grantees/contractors.
* Help with the preparation of presentations and other written materials for internal and external audiences.
* Other duties as assigned to support the overall goals and mission of the department/organization.

Requirements
  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in grants management activities related to the duties described above; OR a master’s degree in non-profit management, public administration, public policy or other relevant field from an accredited college and at least one year of experience in grants management activities related to the duties described above.
* Commitment to sexual and reproductive rights and gender justice preferred.
* Understands the experiences, issues and needs of the TGNCNB community.
* Excellent computer skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Strong research, written and interpersonal communication skills.

Founded in 1971 in Long Island City, Queens **,** LaGuardia Community College is one of seven community colleges of the City University of New York (CUNY). LaGuardia offers more than sixty associate degree programs and more than fifty workforce training, ESOL, GED, and pre-college programs. In 2023, LaGuardia served approximately 24,000 students. More than one-third of LaGuardia’s degree-seeking students are born outside the United States; they come from 136 countries and speak 43 heritage languages. Sixty percent are first-generation college students.

Virtually all LaGuardia students are ethnic minorities (89 percent), 58 percent are women, 27 percent are over the age of 25. Forty-six percent of associate degree students are Hispanic. Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

CUNY SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

No

The Research Coordinator will support the implementation and daily operations of *Our Stories, Our Bodies, Our Safety* , a community-engaged research project examining experiences of safety, community violence, mental health, and well-being among Black pregnant and postpartum women in New York City.

  

Under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI), the Research Coordinator will oversee participant recruitment and engagement, coordinate data collection activities, maintain study documentation, and support community partnerships. The Coordinator will help ensure research activities are implemented efficiently, ethically, and in accordance with institutional and IRB-approved protocols.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

**1. Participant Recruitment and Enrollment (25%)**

* Develop and implement participant recruitment strategies in collaboration with the PI.
* Coordinate outreach to community organizations, maternal health programs, and other recruitment partners.
* Distribute recruitment materials through approved community and digital channels.
* Conduct participant eligibility screening and coordinate informed consent procedures in accordance with approved study protocols.
* Maintain recruitment logs and track enrollment progress toward study targets.
Schedule participant research appointments and communicate study expectations.  

  

**2. Study Coordination and Data Collection (25%)**

* Coordinate administration of study surveys and scheduling of qualitative interviews.
* Monitor completion of study activities and follow up with participants as appropriate.
* Assist with distributing, tracking, and collecting Fitbit devices used during the 14-day monitoring period.
* Maintain accurate records of participant study participation and completion.
* Coordinate participant compensation and maintain incentive distribution records.
Identify and communicate operational challenges to the PI.  

  

**3. Data Management and Research Documentation (20%)**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential research records.
* Assist with data entry, quality assurance, and verification of survey and participant tracking data.
* Manage secure participant databases and study tracking spreadsheets.
* Ensure research data are stored and handled in accordance with institutional confidentiality and data security requirements.
* Support preparation of research progress summaries and recruitment reports.
Assist with maintaining IRB documentation and protocol compliance.  

  

**4. Community Engagement and Participant Retention (20%)**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants regarding study logistics.
* Maintain culturally responsive, respectful, and trauma-informed communication with participants.
* Coordinate participant reminders, follow-up appointments, and retention activities.
* Support relationships with community-based organizations and maternal health stakeholders.
* Identify barriers to participation and work with the PI to develop appropriate solutions.
Assist with coordinating community engagement activities and dissemination efforts.  

  

**5. Administrative and Project Support (10%)**

* Attend regular study team meetings and provide updates on recruitment and project progress.
* Coordinate study schedules, supplies, and research materials.
* Assist with preparing reports and other grant-related documentation.
* Maintain study timelines and track completion of assigned project milestones.
Perform other research-related duties as assigned by the PI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, public health, social work, sociology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple research activities and maintain accurate records.
* Experience working with diverse populations and demonstrated cultural sensitivity.
* Ability to maintain participant confidentiality and follow established research protocols.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar data management tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience coordinating research studies or supporting community-based research.
* Experience with recruitment, informed consent, survey administration, or participant tracking.
* Familiarity with maternal health, mental health, reproductive health, or health equity research.
* Experience working with Black women, families, and historically underserved communities.
* Familiarity with REDCap or other research data collection platforms.
* Knowledge of human subjects research protections and IRB procedures.
Experience with wearable health technologies or digital health research.  

  

**Supervision and Reporting**

The Research Coordinator will report directly to Dr. Brianna A. Baker, Principal Investigator, and will work collaboratively with other research team members and community partners.

  

**Expected Outcomes**

The Research Coordinator will contribute to the successful recruitment and enrollment of approximately 30 participants, timely completion of study activities, accurate maintenance of research documentation, strong participant engagement and retention, and successful implementation of the project's research objective

**About the Company**

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

**Our Ethos**

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

**About the Team**

The Platform team owns everything that happens after a partner signs with Rain: implementations, account management, support, and card network operations. Account Management is responsible for growing Rain's live partners, from developers and startups to enterprise card programs, through renewals, expansions into new products and regions, and commercial conversations.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will own renewals and expansions for a set of live partners in your coverage area, and be the person they go to when something about their partnership, program setup, contract, or products needs to change. Our Implementations team launches new partners; you take over once they are live. You will start by shadowing experienced AMs on renewals and expansions, then run them with an AM alongside you, then on your own.

**What you’ll do**

* Own renewals for the live partners, from the first conversation through signed paperwork
* Find and close expansion opportunities in your accounts, such as new products (cards, virtual accounts, on/offramps, wallets, cross-border payments), additional card programs, and new regions
* Grow net revenue retention (NRR) for your coverage area, and flag churn or contraction risk early
* Handle partner escalations that sit outside Support: questions about the partnership, program configuration, commercial terms, and products. Bring in Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance when needed and follow each one through to resolution
* Keep detailed account health and notes up to date
* Build a health snapshot of your accounts and use it to decide where to spend your time
* Pass partner feedback to Product to help shape the roadmap
* Help write and improve Account Management playbooks, including expansion playbooks for new products and features
* Learn Rain's products in depth, including stablecoin card issuing, card network basics, and our APIs

**You are likely to succeed if you have:**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in account management, as an account executive, or in customer success, in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS
* Comfort talking with partners about renewals, pricing, and commercial terms, and asking for the expansion when the opportunity is there
* Clear written and verbal communication on calls, over email, and in shared Slack channels with partners
* Strong organization: you can keep many accounts, deadlines, and follow-ups moving at the same time
* Curiosity about how payments work (card issuing, authorization, settlement) and about stablecoins, and a willingness to learn technical topics, including reading API documentation
* Ownership: when a partner raises an issue, you see it through to resolution, even when it needs help from several teams
* Comfort working at a fast-growing company

**Bonus attributes:**

* Exposure to card issuing, embedded finance, crypto, or stablecoins
* Experience working toward a renewal, upsell, or expansion target

**Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:**

**Unlimited time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

**Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

**Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

**Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

**Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

**Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

**In-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

**Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Compensation Range: $90K - $115K

Our AM Trainees earn between $46,000 - $53,000 + an 11.5% bonus. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

---------------------------

At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

jobs.title: Account Executive | Inside Sales
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Ramp's SMB sales team runs a high-velocity, full-cycle sales motion. We sell Ramp's full platform (corporate cards, expense management, bill pay, and procurement) to businesses with up to 150 employees, working with their founders, CEOs, and finance leaders.

In this role, you'll help small businesses find a better way to manage their spend and run their finances. You'll own each customer relationship from the first conversation through close: learning how the business operates today, uncovering what's slowing the team down, and showing how Ramp solves it. It's a fast-moving seat with a lot of customer conversations, so you'll sharpen your discovery and closing craft quickly and see your impact in every customer you bring on.

This is a role for a seller who has done the work at both ends of the funnel: someone who started their sales career as an SDR, earned a closing seat, and wants a much bigger volume of at-bats. You'll get coaching, a team that shares what works, and clear paths to grow into Commercial sales, Ramp's newer AI product teams, account management, or leadership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the full sales cycle for SMB customers, from discovery and demo through pricing, negotiation, and close.
* Run 10–12 customer conversations a day while keeping a clean, accurate pipeline and forecast.
* Close at high volume (the team expects 50–60 new customers a month per rep once ramped).
* Self-source part of your business through daily outbound (about 10% of your closed-won customers).
* Run focused discovery with founders, CEOs, and finance leaders, and connect Ramp to the pain they describe.
* Learn Ramp's products and internal tools quickly, and adapt as products and workflows change.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 2–3 years of combined sales experience, including at least one year in a quota-carrying, closing AE role.
* A start in sales development (SDR or BDR) or another outbound role, with a track record of self-sourcing pipeline.
* Experience selling SaaS or tech, ideally a product similar to Ramp.
* A track record as a top performer against quota.
* Comfort leading pricing and negotiation conversations.
* Strong organization: you can prioritize a large book of deals and keep each one moving.
* Comfort with change and ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-intensity environment.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience selling to executive buyers such as CFOs, CEOs, or directors of finance.
* Familiarity with finance or Office of the CFO topics (we'll coach this).
* Experience managing a pipeline in Gong or a similar deal board with forecast categories.

**Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

**Other notices**
-----------------

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

*Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

Compensation Range: $165K

Spectrum Reach® provides custom advertising solutions for local, regional and national clients. Spectrum Reach creates scalable advertising and marketing services driven by aggregated and de-identified data insights and award-winning creative services. Spectrum Reach helps businesses of all sizes reach anyone, anywhere, on any screen. Additional information about Spectrum Reach can be found at https://www.spectrumreach.com.

**SUMMARY**

The Advanced Advertising Account Manager is a strategic partner in providing support to the Enterprise National Agency Partnerships Sales Team. This position will efficiently act as a key partner to Sales, our customers, and various cross-functional teams. This role will drive strategy, planning, account management, and customer stewardship for a portfolio of national brands across our direct-sold business.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Account assignments will consist of national brands, represented by major holding companies and agencies in coordination with industry partners.
* Act as the account lead ensuring end to end account/campaign management including quality assurance checks, oversight of post-sale campaign management by Account Specialists and helping with campaign implementation and reporting
* Serve as a subject matter expert in the field of advanced advertising internally and for our customers
* Manage client relationships and act as point of contact for any client questions in partnership with Sales and Account Specialist.
* Partner with Sales to understand client KPIs/ROIs and work with multiple cross-functional teams to strategize, plan, and build effective proposals.
* Actively and consistently support all efforts to simplify and enhance the customer experience for our advanced TV deals.
* Utilize Spectrum’s data assets and other research metrics to develop proposals for clients including but not limited to targeting and measurement recommendations.
* Drive advanced advertising strategy and revenue through partnering with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Marketing Research, Audience Analytics, Yield & Inventory, Product Data Insights, Data Sales & Reporting, Finance and Traffic/AdOps.
* Understand key performance metrics surrounding multi-screen campaigns to help maximize inventory usage, ensure proposal delivery, and identify upsell opportunities.
* Stay ahead of the curve on marketplace trends relating to their clients as well as the advanced advertising industry.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Expertise in the advanced advertising space and knowledge of media terms/media math  
  Ability to decipher between client needs, for example, ‘branding’ campaigns VS ‘call to action’
* Understanding of relevant metrics when measuring campaign performance
* Demonstrates organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent problem solver with expertise in leveraging cross-functional resources
* Previous experience at a hold co/agency or supporting a team of Sales, Advertising, or Marketing professionals is preferred
* Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communications with overarching skill to translate data and information, prioritize workload, and work against demanding deadlines
* Experience in computer software including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint
* Collaborative mindset, ready to work with multiple cross-functional departments

**RELATED WORK EXPERIENCE**

* Experience across direct-sold and programmatic
* Experience with CRM platforms and Ad Serving software

**EDUCATION**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

Experience in Media Sales or as a Media Buyer - 3-5+ yrs

The base pay for this position generally is between **$73,200.00 and $140,600.00**. The actual compensation offered will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Supported by our 100% U.S.-based employees,\* we are America's Internet Company®.

Spectrum is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including job seekers with disabilities and veterans. Learn about Life at Spectrum.

jobs.title: Corporate Traveler - Customer Success Manager - New York, NY
jobs.description:
**Job no:** 533448 - B
  
**Brand:** Corporate Traveler (US)
  
**Work type:** Full time
  
**Location:** New York
  
**Categories:** Sales and Customer Service

**Customer Success Manager**

  

A world where tech and people work collectively to make corporate travel simpler, faster and easier.

  

Corporate Traveler is one of Flight Centre Travel Group’s (FCTG) most successful brands, globally. Our mission is to dominate the SME market, making the end-to-end travel experience faster, simpler and easier for our customers and to demonstrate ongoing value to decision-makers, travelers and bookers. We provide our customers with the perfect blend of personal, local service blended with our expert technology suite and the great choice and value which comes with being part of the FCTG family. For decades, we’ve been helping go-getter businesses grow through travel.

  

Corporate Traveler has offices across a global network that spans Australia, Canada, USA, UK, South Africa and New Zealand. The brand has been part of the Flight Centre Travel Group for more than 26 years and is a key contributor to the ongoing strength of FCTG’s corporate travel division. Award winning, forward thinking and fun to work for – this is a business for people who love travel, are team players and customer service oriented.

  

To learn more about Corporate Traveler please click HERE

  

**About The Opportunity**

Corporate Traveler USA is looking for a commercially minded Customer Success Manager to own and grow a portfolio of valued customer accounts. In this highly visible role, you'll become the trusted advisor for your customers, driving retention, revenue growth, and long-term program success while delivering exceptional service experiences. You'll lead strategic business reviews, uncover growth opportunities, and partner closely with Sales and Operations to help customers maximize the value of their travel programs. If you're passionate about building relationships, driving results, and creating meaningful customer outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, acting as the primary relationship owner and trusted advisor.
* Lead proactive account management through account planning, strategic customer engagement, review meetings, and ongoing relationship development.
* Coordinate and lead new customer Hypercare activities to ensure successful onboarding and long-term adoption.
* Drive customer retention, program health, and revenue growth across assigned accounts.
* Identify and execute opportunities to increase TTV growth, hotel attachment, supplier adoption, referrals, and additional services.
* Conduct regular business reviews, presenting program performance, savings, ROI, and future recommendations.
* Own all customer communications, ensuring timely, professional, and value-driven engagement.
* Respond to customer feedback, action survey results, and partner with leadership to drive continuous improvement.
* Maintain accurate Salesforce records including account plans, opportunities, meetings, risk plans, and case notes.
* Identify at-risk accounts and develop mitigation plans to improve retention and customer outcomes.
* Build relationships across multiple stakeholder levels including Travel Leads, Finance, Procurement, and executive leadership.
* Collaborate with Sales and Operations teams to support account growth, customer success, and seamless customer experiences.
* Other duties and tasks as assigned
* Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive
  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum 2 years of Customer Success, Account Management, or related B2B experience.
* Proven success managing customer accounts with accountability for retention and growth.
* Experience building relationships with customers and engaging senior stakeholders.
* Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM for opportunity management, case management, and activity tracking.
* Working knowledge of online booking tools such as Melon, SAP Concur, or similar platforms.
* Experience within corporate travel management, TMC, or a related industry is preferred.
* Familiarity with PowerBI, Gong, or similar analytics platforms is preferred.
* College degree or equivalent advanced education preferred.
  

**Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:**

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. Falcon Rappaport & Berkman LLP is a full-service, rapidly growing, and entrepreneurial law firm focused on an interdisciplinary approach to the practice. Our team is composed of thought leaders across a variety of practice areas, including some of the nation’s leading voices on AI, taxation, and a variety of other fields.

We bring together experts across all of our departments to achieve extraordinary results. With us, respect, appreciation, and quality of life come first and foremost. We care deeply about the people we bring into our firm and offer a unique emphasis on professional development, marketing, and overall balance. We work collaboratively across the entire firm to drive client success.

**Position Overview:**  
The Project Manager serves as chief of staff to the Firm’s newly formed Innovation Office and acts as right hand to the Chief Innovation Officer (CIO). The office leads the Firm’s adoption of artificial intelligence, builds and deploys new technology and workflows, and supports the Firm’s AI practice. The Project Manager keeps the department’s priorities, projects, people, and commitments organized and moving, and extends the CIO’s reach across the Firm. The role also includes a client-facing component on the legal side, working directly with clients and supporting the business development activities of the department.

We are looking for someone who is exceptionally organized and who does not assume work has to be done the way it has always been done. AI tools are changing what one person can accomplish. **Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with the CIO to set, track, and drive the department’s priorities, and own follow-through on decisions and action items.

* Prepare agendas, briefing materials, memos, presentations, and reports for the CIO, Firm leadership, and the Management Committee.
* Serve as the CIO’s liaison to Firm leadership, practice groups, administrative departments, clients, vendors, and other external stakeholders, and represent the CIO in meetings as needed.
* Triage incoming requests to the CIO and the department, resolving what can be resolved and escalating what cannot.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

**Department Operations and Project Management**

* Run the department’s operating rhythm, including weekly meetings, quarterly priorities, scorecards, and progress reporting.
* Plan, track, and manage a portfolio of concurrent initiatives, such as AI tool rollouts, technology builds, training programs, and vendor evaluations, from kickoff through completion.
* Maintain a single source of truth for department projects, deadlines, owners, and status, and surface risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate work across innovation team members, attorneys, staff, and outside vendors and consultants.
* Support budgeting, vendor management, license and contract renewals, and expense tracking for the department.
* Coordinate department events, trainings, internal build days, webinars, and speaking engagements.

**Reimagining How Work Gets Done**

* Use leading AI tools as a core part of daily work, and model AI-first habits for the department and the Firm.
* Examine department and Firm processes, identify where AI and automation can eliminate, accelerate, or improve work, and propose and pilot better approaches.
* Build and maintain practical automations, agents, templates, and prompts that save time for the CIO, the department, and the Firm.
* Document new workflows clearly so others can adopt them, and help colleagues learn to use them.
* Track and report on the adoption and impact of the Firm’s AI initiatives.
* Stay current on developments in AI tools and bring practical ideas to the team.

**Client-Facing Legal Practice Support**

* Interact directly with clients of the CIO and the AI practice, serving as a day-to-day point of contact for scheduling, status updates, and logistics.
* Schedule and coordinate client meetings, calls, and workshops, and prepare agendas, materials, and follow-up.
* Orchestrate business development activities for the department, including pitches, proposals, client events, webinars, and conference appearances, and keep follow-up with clients and prospects on track.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 4+ years of experience in project management, operations, chief of staff, or senior executive support roles, preferably in a professional services firm (law, accounting, consulting, financial services, etc.) or a technology company.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with a proven ability to manage many projects, deadlines, and stakeholders at once without anything falling through the cracks.

* Help drive projects and initiatives to nurture team culture (social events, team cadence...)
* Punctual, regular, and consistent attendance

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications/Skills**

* 2+ years relevant experience supporting senior-level executives
* Exceptional communications skills (verbal and written) and strong interpersonal skills
* Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and operate proactively with limited direction.
* Experience coordinating large, hybrid meetings and executive-level events.
* Solid follow-through, with the ability to track commitments and drive administrative work to completion.
* Advanced proficiency with MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint) and MS Teams
* Ability to successfully multi-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent at problem-solving, taking initiative, and being resourceful
* Approachable, friendly demeanor in dealing with executives, employees, vendors, and customers and skilled at developing relationships and working with a variety of personalities
* Exceptional organizational skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.description:

#### **NOW HIRING**

Part-Time Community Liaison & Business Development Coordinator

Location: Metro Atlanta, GA

Position Type: Part-Time | 15–20 Hours Per Week

Schedule: Flexible Weekdays | Primarily Field-Based

Compensation: Competitive Hourly Pay + Performance Incentives

#### **About the Position**

Avanta Care is seeking an energetic, professional, and results-driven Community Liaison & Business Development Coordinator to expand our presence throughout Metro Atlanta.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys networking, building professional relationships, and connecting families with quality home care services.

We are looking for a confident, independent professional who can represent Avanta Care in the community, develop strong referral partnerships, and contribute directly to business growth.

This is a relationship-building and client acquisition position, not a traditional social media marketing role.

Business Development & Client Growth

* Track leads, followups, meetings, and referral outcomes.
* Provide weekly activity and business development reports.

* Experience in home care, healthcare marketing, senior living, community outreach, or business development preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable approaching new organizations and establishing professional relationships.
* Strong organizational and followup skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage a flexible schedule.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel throughout Metro Atlanta.
* Experience with CRM systems is a plus.

#### **Performance Expectations**

#### **The successful candidate will be expected to:**

* Develop 1015 new professional contacts weekly.
* Complete 2025 referral followups weekly.
* Schedule 35 business development meetings weekly.
* Maintain an active pipeline of qualified referral opportunities.
* Contribute to measurable growth in client inquiries and new service starts.

Performance will be evaluated based on relationship development, consistent outreach, referral activity, and overall contribution to business growth.

We want someone who is not afraid to walk into a hospital, introduce themselves to a discharge planner, or sit down with a senior living director to explain how Avanta Care can support their clients and families.

The right person is polished, personable, persistent, resourceful, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

We are not simply looking for someone to market our services. We are looking for someone who can open doors, build relationships, and create opportunities for growth.

#### **What We Offer**

* Flexible parttime schedule
* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performancebased incentive opportunities
* Supportive leadership
* Opportunity for professional growth
* Potential to transition into a larger business development role as the company expands

#### **How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting relevant experience in healthcare, community outreach, relationship management, or business development.

#### **Avanta Care**

Building Relationships. Connecting Families. Growing With Purpose.

#### **About Avanta Care LLC**

At Avanta Care, we are committed to delivering compassionate, personalized home health care that enhances the quality of life for our clients. With a focus on dignity, comfort, and trust, our team of skilled caregivers and nurses provide tailored care solutions to meet individual needs. We work closely with families to ensure peace of mind, offering services that range from daily support to specialized medical care, all within the comfort of home. Avanta Care is dedicated to being your trusted partner in providing exceptional care.

jobs.title: Aviation Warehouse Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**
---------------

Deployments for Flock’s aviation hardware are expanding across communities as more agencies adopt drone technology. Delivering those systems reliably requires hands-on warehouse operations that turn dozens of complex sub-components into complete, field-ready hardware packages. You will keep this pipeline moving, preparing every order so field technicians have every cable, mount, and assembly ready to install out of the box.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Assemble Dock 3 units and associated platform hardware to prepare each system for field deployment.
* Kit and package customer-facing orders of up to 50 individual SKUs, including specialized cables, mounts, and accessories, with precise attention to detail.
* Manage inbound and outbound logistics by receiving shipments, staging materials, and coordinating timely freight handoffs.
* Maintain accurate stock records by serializing all received aviation hardware and conducting regular cycle counts.
* Operate warehouse equipment safely, including forklifts and pallet jacks, to stage inventory and maintain an organized workspace.
* Respond promptly to tactical updates and shipping requests across internal communication channels to prevent deployment delays.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a specialized single-function warehouse position; you will handle receiving, assembly, kitting, inventory tracking, and shipping across the entire aviation product line.
* This is not a remote or desk role, as daily work takes place on-site in the warehouse preparing physical equipment.
* This isn't a software flashing or firmware role, as your responsibilities center on physical hardware assembly, kitting, and material movement.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Experience working in warehouse logistics, high-volume order fulfillment, or technology hardware distribution.
* Familiarity managing a large variety of complex SKUs and multi-part hardware kits.
* Experience operating standard warehouse equipment such as forklifts and pallet jacks.
* Strong responsiveness across written communication tools like Slack and email to coordinate rapidly moving orders.
* Ability to work autonomously and manage daily warehouse operations independently when needed.

**Compensation**
----------------

In this role, you’ll receive a starting hourly range between $21 and $24 as well as Flock Safety Stock Options. Base pay is determined by job-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in-depth with you during our first chat.

**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.

Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub-based roles mean real in-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.

The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.

On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.

One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**About SMARD Art**  
SMARD Art is a Black-owned, global company and the world’s leading retailer of Black art. Our work is available at T.J. Maxx, HomeGoods, and Marshalls. Our mission is to make Black art mainstream and help it find a place in every home.

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Social Media Manager who is a creative in their own right. You can take a vision and make it real, and you'll bring ideas we wouldn’t have without you. You trust your eye, can explain why a creative choice works, and can take an idea from a conversation to something people want to watch and share.

You will own SMARD Art’s social channels, personally create original content, and manage our Social Media Coordinator. You’ll work with a team of creatives to bring campaigns to life and pitch ideas of your own. You’ll also help shape how the brand sounds in conversation with our community and appear on camera when the content calls for it.

This is a demanding, fast-paced startup role. You’ll be balancing channels, campaigns, and deadlines while building the systems that help the team grow. We’re looking for someone driven by the mission and excited to show the world what we’re building.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own social strategy and execution. Set the direction for Instagram and TikTok, build the content calendar, and manage publishing across campaigns, product launches, and events.
* Bring creative ideas to life. Collaborate with the creative team to translate campaign concepts into social content. Pitch original ideas and personally script, shoot, and edit short-form videos, from product and lifestyle storytelling to behind-the-scenes moments. Create graphics and templates in Canva as needed.
* Represent SMARD Art on camera. Capture lifestyle content in the moment, speak naturally on camera, and appear in content on behalf of the brand when the story calls for it.
* Build and engage our community. Carry a conversational brand voice across posts, comments, and DMs. Build relationships with followers, artists, creators, and brand advocates. Create opportunities for people to participate and share their own content, and handle sensitive conversations with sound judgment.
* Manage the Social Media Coordinator. Set priorities, delegate clearly, and give constructive feedback that helps them grow and keeps the work moving.
* Build systems that can scale. Set up practical workflows for planning, production, approvals, publishing, and reporting so multiple campaigns and channels can move at once.  
  Use insights to improve the work. Follow audience behavior, platform trends, and relevant cultural conversations. Track performance, report what you’re learning, and use it to decide what to make, test, or develop further.

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* A demonstrated commitment to celebrating Black culture through creativity. This is essential. Your work should show a distinct perspective and a pulse on the artists, ideas, and cultural moments shaping Black communities in the U.S. and across the diaspora. You know what will resonate with our community and when SMARD Art has something meaningful to add.
* Experience owning social accounts for a brand or public-facing individual. You’ve been directly responsible for publishing, community engagement, and performance, and you can speak to results you helped drive.
* Hands-on short-form production skills. You can take an idea from concept to a publish-ready video. You have a strong eye for visuals, sound, and pacing, and you’re comfortable editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or a comparable tool and creating assets in Canva.
* Community-building experience and a natural voice. You know how to turn audience interaction into relationships, and you bring personality and judgment to how you write, speak, and represent a brand.
* Exceptional organization and strong people skills. You can juggle multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and build your own systems to keep projects moving. You’re comfortable giving feedback and taking initiative when priorities shift.

  

**Nice To Have**

* A creative practice or original work you make independently.
* A global perspective shaped by travel, lived experience, or creative work across communities.
* Experience managing or mentoring someone.
* Experience building workflows at a startup or on a small team.

  

**How To Apply**

Please share:

* Examples of social accounts you’ve managed, what you owned, and one result you helped drive.
* Two or three short-form videos you personally created, with a quick note on what you handled for each.
* A few sentences on the creative perspective you’d bring to SMARD Art and where we can see it in your work.

**About Company:**

**Build Your Future With a Company That Builds What’s Next**

At NetPlanner Systems, we don’t just keep up with technology — we help shape how organizations use it to stay ahead. As one of the Southeast’s leading providers of IT‑based solutions, we’ve spent more than 35 years delivering innovation, reliability, and the kind of service that turns clients into long‑term partners.

Our growth and success have earned us recognition as one of Georgia’s fastest‑growing middle‑market companies, a two‑time Inc. 5000 honoree, and one of Metro Atlanta’s Top 100 Workplaces. But what truly defines us isn’t the awards — it’s our people.

### **A Culture Built on Ownership, Collaboration, and Real Opportunity**

NetPlanner is a place where you can do meaningful work alongside people who genuinely care about what they do. We value curiosity, teamwork, and the drive to solve problems that matter. Our culture is built on:

* **Ownership** — As of October 31, 2025, we are 100% employee‑owned. When you join NetPlanner, you become an owner. Your ideas matter. Your work matters. And your success is tied directly to the success of the company.
* **Growth** — We invest in our people. From hands‑on learning to leadership development programs, we create pathways for you to grow your skills and your career.
* **Stability + Innovation** — With decades of proven performance and a forward‑thinking mindset, we offer the rare combination of long‑term stability and cutting‑edge opportunity.
* **Community** — We’re big enough to make an impact, but small enough that you’ll know the people you work with. Collaboration isn’t a buzzword here — it’s how we operate every day.

### **Why NetPlanner? Because Your Work Should Mean Something**

When you join us, you’re not just filling a role — you’re contributing to a company where your work has real impact and your future grows right alongside ours. You’ll be part of a team that celebrates wins together, supports each other, and takes pride in delivering excellence.

If you’re looking for a place where you can build a career, make a difference, and be part of something bigger, we’d love to meet you.

**About the Role:**

The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient and timely movement of goods throughout the warehouse. This position is responsible for coordinating all aspects of logistics operations, including inventory management, warehousing, shipping, and receiving activities. The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams to optimize transportation routes and warehouse utilization, minimizing costs while maintaining high service levels. They will also monitor shipment schedules, resolve any logistical issues, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Ultimately, the Logistics Coordinator ensures that products are delivered accurately and on time, supporting overall business objectives and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, or related field preferred.
* Proven experience in logistics coordination, warehouse management, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of shipping and receiving procedures and regulations within the United States.
* Proficiency with logistics software and inventory management systems.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in logistics or supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CSCMP).
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Familiarity with customs regulations and international shipping processes.
* Ability to analyze data to improve logistics processes and reduce costs.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and monitor the entire order cycle to enhance business development and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage warehouse operations including inventory control, stock replenishment, and space optimization.
* Schedule and track shipments, liaising with carriers and freight companies to ensure timely delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of shipping and receiving activities, including documentation and compliance with regulations.
* Identify and resolve logistical problems, such as delays or discrepancies, proactively communicating with relevant stakeholders.

**Skills:**

The required skills in logistics management, warehouse management, warehousing, and shipping and receiving are applied daily to coordinate and streamline the flow of goods from suppliers to customers. The Logistics Coordinator uses logistics management skills to plan and execute transportation strategies that reduce costs and improve delivery times. Warehouse management and warehousing skills are essential for maintaining accurate inventory levels, organizing storage space efficiently, and ensuring smooth receiving and dispatching operations. Shipping and receiving expertise enables the coordinator to handle documentation, compliance, and communication with carriers effectively. Preferred skills such as proficiency with logistics software and certifications enhance the ability to analyze data, optimize processes, and adapt to evolving supply chain challenges.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. The employee must be able to stand, walk, bend, kneel, squat, and climb for extended periods. The employee must also be able to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.

**Where Trust Leads, Bold Ideas Grow, and Community Thrives**

Paula's Choice, a global skincare leader founded in 1995, empowers individuals to define beauty on their own terms through science-backed products. Our mission comes to life through four core values that guide our actions, decisions, and impact:

* **Build Trust:** We set the standard for skincare, transparency, and shared knowledge.
* **Be Bold:** We lead through innovation and by challenging the status quo.
* **Act with Kindness:** We operate with respect and care—for our customers, colleagues, and the planet.
* **Create Community:** We believe in the power of connection—whether educating customers, supporting each other, or giving back, we grow stronger together.

Our team spans North America, Australia/New Zealand, Europe, and the broader APAC region, collaborating globally to drive innovation. We offer space to thrive—personally, professionally, and through our comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at every stage:

* Generous paid time off, including time off to volunteer
* Learning and development resources to support personal and professional growth
* Wellness benefits like meditation app memberships, product discounts, and free samples of our amazing products
* Most roles are fully remote (roles that are required to be at our Seattle HQ can be found in the details section of this job post)
* Great location – for roles that are hybrid or fully onsite, we're in the heart of Seattle's beautiful International District
* Did we mention we're a dog-friendly office?

Our culture encourages continuous learning and is fueled by connection, curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration. Whether onsite, remote, or hybrid, we stay connected through shared initiatives that bring our teams together. If you're inspired by transparency, driven to make an impact, and eager to help foster community—we'd love to have you join us.

**How you'll have an impact at Paula's Choice:**

The Account Coordinator (AC) is a retail-focused individual who partners with their leader to drive sales revenue in a multi-door, territory. This role is responsible for building strong retailer relationships, training and coaching in-store associates, modeling successful side-by side selling in stores, planning and executing in-store events, maintaining and upholding merchandising standards, plus leading promotional activities and product launch initiatives to reach sales targets at Sephora.

**As an Account Coordinator (AC) a typical day might include a mix of the following:**

**Strategy/Administrative**

* In partnership with leader, develop territory strategy to reach Sephora sales target and provide growth YOY, assuring focus on elevating the brand awareness to reach maximum ROI.
* Plan and execute territory event door strategy to provide YOY growth and deliver weekly results and feedback to leadership.
* Plan, schedule and execute territory call cycle for maximum business growth.
* Track sales and training performance, communicate opportunities to leader.
* Participate in Bi-Weekly and Monthly B&M meetings and communicate any business opportunities within territory.
* Maintain organization to ensure deadlines are being met, including but not limited to calendars, T&E budgets, weekly sales recaps, event recaps, store visit recaps, store visit schedules, travel bookings and other administrative responsibilities.

**HR/Communication**

* Participate in regular touch bases with team to assure strong communication and partnership alignment.
* Diplomatically address and resolve any store level challenges to maintain strong relationships and ensure solid brand integrity.

**Training Support**

* Participate in product training webinars, in-person training courses and special education focused events to build expertise in the brand and category.
* Execute successful implementation of all sales and training support tools regarding new product launches and daily in-store visits to achieve 5-star service scores.
* In partnership with leader and Education team, support the execution of elevated training opportunities.

**Sales Support**

* Plan and execute in-store events including elevated brand experience events and provide in-store partnership to achieve sales targets.
* Communicate all store level feedback in a timely manner.
* Execute on maintaining the highest level of standards to all merchandising guidelines and in-store activations
* Execute regular business reviews with in-store retail partners to communicate trending business and negotiate elevated store training opportunities and event strategies to drive retail sales growth
* Manage any out of stock or visual merchandising needs with retail partners, following all retailer brand guidelines.

**The Details:**

* Hours: Full-time role that will require flexibility to work some evenings, weekends and some holidays:
* + **Tuesday – Saturday Schedule**
* Physical requirements: Ability to lift 40 pounds and stand up to 8 hours on your feet in stores
* Travel requirements: Up to 80 % travel, territories can vary based on geographical areas and are subject to change based on business needs (\*Transportation costs policy will be covered in the interview process)
* 20% Office/ Administrative Time: To include but not limited to: onboarding & ongoing training, booking in-store visits & travel, expense reports, store visit and event recaps, weekly communications, etc.
* **Chicago, IL** area with a minimum of 1 hour or less proximity to high volume location;
* + **Michigan Avenue Sephora**
* Reliable transportation is required

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* 2+ years minimum of beauty industry experience or equivalently relevant qualified experience
* 1+ years minimum of managing a multi-door, multi-retailer territory
* 1+ years minimum of retail sales and training experience in a Sephora environment
* Valid Passport and ability to travel within your region 80% of the time
* Know

**Description**

  
What We’re Looking For:  
  
Are you an attentive Account Manager with experience in serving SaaS customers? We're actively seeking professionals like yourself to join our dynamic team and take charge of managing, renewing, and driving growth for our valued accounts. As an Account Manager, you'll play a crucial role in nurturing existing client relationships and maximizing their potential.  
  
Meltwater offers more than employment—it's a voyage towards personal and professional advancement. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere that nurtures your skills, encourages mentorship, and champions inclusive leadership practices. Interact with experienced account managers and resilient leaders who are dedicated to supporting your growth journey.  
  
Join our team, where you'll be embraced by a diverse community that honors your individual contributions and propels you toward realizing your full potential.

At Meltwater, we believe great impact deserves great reward. Our compensation approach is data-driven, market-informed, and built to scale with your growth. We benchmark roles against external market data and use structured leveling frameworks to ensure fairness, consistency, and internal equity across teams and geographies.  
  
These frameworks are based on objective, gender-neutral criteria in line with applicable pay transparency regulations.  
  
For this role, the base salary range is $75,000–$90,000 USD.  
  
The expected On-Target Earnings (OTE) range is $125,000–$150,000, inclusive of base salary and performance-based variable pay.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
* Experience working directly at or with major social platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and managing ongoing technical operations.
* Strong understanding of AI/automation in digital media; hands-on experience using or implementing AI tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and client communication skills, with a proven track record of managing and meeting strict contractual client SLAs.
* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions, effectively collaborating across departments (Product, Engineering, Sales, BD) to achieve client objectives.
* Comfort operating in a fluid, evolving role with undefined or shifting responsibilities; adaptability is essential.
* BA/BS required.

### **Success Measures**

* **Client Satisfaction and Retention:** High client satisfaction scores and strong retention and growth of client business.
* **Operational Efficiency and AI-Implementation:** Measurable time savings and workflow improvements achieved for client support operations through implementation of AI tools.
* **Business Acumen in Practice:** Demonstrated ability to apply contract and SLA knowledge to day-to-day prioritization, escalation, and client management decisions.
* **Critical Thinking & Navigating Ambiguity:** Proven ability to operate in complex, undefined situations — applying critical thinking, building structure without formal guidance, and making sound decisions with incomplete information.

As part of IAS compensation package, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance (medical, dental, vision) as well as PPO, HSA and FSA options and 401k with employer matching contributions. All full-time employee roles include competitive compensation and are eligible for an annual bonus and/or other incentive plans. Each candidate’s compensation package is based on multiple factors, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need.

jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Randa Apparel & Accessories**

**Product Developer**

Randa Apparel & Accessories is one of the world’s leading fashion clothing and accessories companies, operating across 11 countries with a portfolio of 30+ iconic brands, including Haggar, Levi’s, Tommy Hilfiger, Calvin Klein, Totes, Isotoner, and Columbia Sportswear. With over 100 years of industry leadership, RAA continues to produce exceptional products and services, delighting customers and empowering partners worldwide. From the #1 dress pant brand in North America to the #1 belt and wallet, RAA sets the standard for excellence and innovation

We empower our associates, create growth opportunities at every level, and strive to make RAA the best place to build a career.

Want to work at a diverse, equitable, & inclusive workspace where associates are encouraged to bring their true, authentic selves?

Apply today and fashion your future with RAA.

**Location**: Rosemont, IL

**Salary Range**: $70,000 - $76,000

**Schedule**: Hybrid Schedule 3 days in office, 2 days remote

**Position Summary**

The Product Developer owns development execution for assigned products from initial development through production readiness. This role is accountable for accurate product information, product feasibility, sample evaluation, issue resolution, and the cross-functional actions required to deliver products that meet design intent, quality, cost, manufacturability, and timing objectives.

Working across internal global teams, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, suppliers, and factory partners, the Product Developer applies product and technical judgment to identify risks early, recommend practical solutions, drive follow-through, and ensure products are ready to support established business commitments.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Own day-to-day development execution for assigned products from initial development through production readiness.
* Maintain and evaluate accurate style setup, Bills of Materials (BOMs), product records, specifications, and development documentation.
* Ensure product information is complete, accurate, and aligned across systems, suppliers, factories, and internal teams.
* Evaluate product construction, materials, components, fit/specifications, workmanship, and manufacturing feasibility throughout development.
* Partner with Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, suppliers, and factories to balance design intent, quality, cost, manufacturability, and timing.
* Identify material, construction, and manufacturing solutions that support product, quality, and cost objectives.
* Troubleshoot product, material, construction, quality, cost, and manufacturing challenges and recommend practical solutions.
* Evaluate development, pre-production (PP), and top-of-production (TOP) samples against approved product direction, specifications, workmanship, and established quality standards.
* Drive sample corrections, approval cycles, revisions, and documentation required to achieve production readiness.
* Maintain visibility to customer, licensor, factory, business, and production deadlines, dependencies, open actions, and risks.
* Identify development or execution risks early, determine appropriate recovery actions, and escalate issues requiring cross-functional or leadership decisions.
* Partner with Sourcing and factory teams to assess manufacturing capabilities and identify appropriate construction methods and development solutions.
* Own accurate documentation, tracking, follow-up, and development-to-production handoffs for assigned products.
* Make informed product-development recommendations and drive actions needed to protect product readiness and established business commitments.
* Share product-development knowledge, reinforce established best practices, and provide guidance to Associate Product Developers.
* Identify recurring execution challenges and use PLM, analytics, reporting, automation, AI-enabled tools, and emerging technologies responsibly to improve consistency, quality, speed, and productivity.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in Product Development, sourcing, supply chain, merchandising, technical product development, or another related product-creation role.
* Strong knowledge of product construction, materials, components, style setup, product information management, BOMs, specifications, samples, approvals, factory communication, and production readiness.
* Experience owning products through development, PP and TOP sample evaluation and approval, commercialization, and production handoff.
* Ability to evaluate product feasibility and workmanship, troubleshoot product and manufacturing issues, recommend solutions, and drive cross-functional follow-through.
* Ability to balance design intent, quality, cost, manufacturability, and timing when making product-development recommendations.
* Strong organizational, communication, product judgment, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple product-development priorities and seasonal deadlines.
* Ability to work independently, escalate appropriately, and influence internal teams, suppliers, and factory partners.
* Experience using PLM, reporting, analytics, automation, AI-enabled tools, and emerging technologies to improve product-development execution and processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Product Developer owns the readiness of assigned products from initial development through production handoff. The role maintains accurate product data and documentation, evaluates construction and samples, resolves product and manufacturing issues, and makes sound recommendations that balance design intent, quality, cost, manufacturability, and timing. Success is demonstrated through production-ready products, effective PP/TOP approvals, complete handoffs, strong cross-functional partnership, increasing independence, and continuous improvement.
